spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m2p2t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
Bays == {"a", "b", "c"}
Total == 2
VARIABLES tokens, pending
vars == <<tokens, pending>>

Idle == [state |-> "idle"]
Sum == tokens["a"] + tokens["b"] + tokens["c"]
Held == IF pending.state = "prepared" THEN pending.amt ELSE 0

Init ==
  /\ tokens = [b \in Bays |-> IF b = "a" THEN Total ELSE 0]
  /\ pending = Idle

Prepare ==
  /\ pending.state = "idle"
  /\ \E b \in Bays, c \in Bays :
       /\ b # c
       /\ tokens[b] > 0
       /\ tokens' = [tokens EXCEPT ![b] = tokens[b] - 1]
       /\ pending' = [state |-> "prepared", from |-> b, to |-> c, amt |-> 1]

Commit ==
  /\ pending.state = "prepared"
  /\ tokens' = [tokens EXCEPT ![pending.to] = tokens[pending.to] + pending.amt]
  /\ pending' = Idle

Abort ==
  /\ pending.state = "prepared"
  /\ tokens' = [tokens EXCEPT ![pending.from] = tokens[pending.from] + pending.amt]
  /\ pending' = Idle

AdminMove ==
  /\ pending.state = "idle"
  /\ \E b \in Bays, c \in Bays :
       /\ b # c
       /\ tokens[b] > 0
       /\ tokens' = [tokens EXCEPT ![b] = tokens[b] - 1, ![c] = tokens[c] + 1]
  /\ pending' = pending

Next == Prepare \/ Commit \/ Abort \/ AdminMove
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
TokenConservation == Sum + Held = Total
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT TokenConservation
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line moves wash-tokens between three staging bays a, b, and c. A coordinator relocates a token from one bay to another using a two-phase commit: it first prepares the transfer, pulling one token out of the source bay and holding it in escrow, and later either commits the token into the destination bay or aborts it back to the source. Only one transfer may be in flight at a time. A privileged shift admin may also shove a single token directly from any non-empty bay to another, bypassing the two-phase protocol. No matter which path is taken, tokens are never minted or destroyed: every token is always either sitting in a bay or held in the escrow of an in-flight transfer. The line starts with all tokens parked in bay a.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of tokens across the three bays plus any token currently held in transfer escrow always equals the fixed total the line started with.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m5p2t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
Robots == {"r1", "r2"}
Total == 2
VARIABLES load, depot, cap
vars == <<load, depot, cap>>

HasSpare == {r \in Robots : load[r] < cap[r]}
Carried == load["r1"] + load["r2"]

Init ==
  /\ load = [r \in Robots |-> 0]
  /\ depot = Total
  /\ cap = [r \in Robots |-> 2]

Deploy ==
  /\ depot > 0
  /\ Cardinality(HasSpare) >= 2
  /\ \E r \in Robots :
       /\ load[r] < cap[r]
       /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![r] = load[r] + 1]
  /\ depot' = depot - 1
  /\ cap' = cap

Return ==
  /\ \E r \in Robots :
       /\ load[r] > 0
       /\ load' = [load EXCEPT ![r] = load[r] - 1]
  /\ depot' = depot + 1
  /\ cap' = cap

Recap ==
  /\ \E r \in Robots, k \in {1, 2, 3} :
       /\ k >= load[r]
       /\ cap' = [cap EXCEPT ![r] = k]
  /\ load' = load
  /\ depot' = depot

Next == Deploy \/ Return \/ Recap
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
ParcelConservation == depot + Carried = Total
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT ParcelConservation
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet of two robots ferries parcels between a central depot and themselves. Deploying a parcel from the depot onto a robot requires a quorum: at least two robots must currently have spare capacity before the move is approved. A robot may also return a parcel to the depot at any time. Each robot's carrying capacity can change at runtime as batteries and racks are swapped, but re-capping never adds or removes parcels. Parcels are a conserved quantity: every parcel is always either in the depot or on exactly one robot.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of parcels in the depot plus the parcels carried by the robots always equals the fixed fleet total.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m4p0t5 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets
Cap == 2
VARIABLES queue, active
vars == <<queue, active>>

Init == queue = << >> /\ active = {}

Enqueue ==
  /\ Len(queue) < Cap
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, "req")
  /\ active' = active

StartClerk ==
  /\ active = {}
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ active' = {"clerk"}
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)

StartAdmin ==
  /\ active = {}
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ active' = {"admin"}
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)

Finish ==
  /\ active # {}
  /\ active' = {}
  /\ queue' = queue

Next == Enqueue \/ StartClerk \/ StartAdmin \/ Finish
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
DeskMutualExclusion == Cardinality(active) <= 1
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT DeskMutualExclusion
nl:
A library book-reservation desk buffers incoming reservation requests in a bounded FIFO queue. When the queue is full, new requests are refused: this is the backpressure. A single clerk pulls the oldest request off the front and works it at the desk; a privileged admin may also grab the oldest request and work it, jumping any staffing rules. Whoever is working, the desk can only be staffed by one worker at a time: the clerk and the admin never process reservations simultaneously. A worker finishes and frees the desk before the next request can start.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one worker (clerk or admin) is actively processing a reservation at the desk at any moment.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od7m0p0t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
Procs == {"p1", "p2", "p3"}
VARIABLES held, crashed, attempts
vars == <<held, crashed, attempts>>

Init == held = {} /\ crashed = {} /\ attempts = 0

Acquire ==
  /\ held = {}
  /\ attempts < 3
  /\ \E p \in Procs :
       /\ p \notin crashed
       /\ held' = held \cup {p}
  /\ attempts' = attempts + 1
  /\ crashed' = crashed

Release ==
  /\ \E p \in Procs :
       /\ p \in held
       /\ p \notin crashed
       /\ held' = held \ {p}
  /\ attempts' = 0
  /\ crashed' = crashed

Crash ==
  /\ \E p \in Procs :
       /\ p \in held
       /\ p \notin crashed
       /\ crashed' = crashed \cup {p}
  /\ held' = held
  /\ attempts' = attempts

ReclaimCrashed ==
  /\ \E p \in Procs :
       /\ p \in held
       /\ p \in crashed
       /\ held' = held \ {p}
       /\ crashed' = crashed \ {p}
  /\ attempts' = 0

Reset ==
  /\ held = {}
  /\ attempts > 0
  /\ attempts' = 0
  /\ held' = held
  /\ crashed' = crashed

Next == Acquire \/ Release \/ Crash \/ ReclaimCrashed \/ Reset
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
MutualExclusion == Cardinality(held) <= 1
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MutualExclusion
nl:
A container-ship crane yard has one shared gantry crane that three dock processes compete to control. A process acquires the crane only when it is free, incrementing a shared attempt counter as its optimistic-lock stamp, and later releases it. A process holding the crane may crash silently: it stops working but is still recorded as the holder, so it neither releases nor can act further. The whole point of the protocol is that the heavy crane is never driven by two processes at once. The attempt counter is bounded so the yard's state stays finite.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one dock process holds the gantry crane at any time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m3p3t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
Players == {"a", "b"}
Servers == {"s1", "s2"}
Slots == {1, 2}
VARIABLES assign, leader, down
vars == <<assign, leader, down>>

Init ==
  /\ assign = [p \in Players |-> 0]
  /\ leader = "none"
  /\ down = {}

Elect ==
  /\ leader = "none"
  /\ \E s \in Servers :
       /\ s \notin down
       /\ leader' = s
  /\ assign' = assign
  /\ down' = down

AssignSlot ==
  /\ leader # "none"
  /\ \E p \in Players, s \in Slots :
       /\ assign[p] = 0
       /\ \A q \in Players : assign[q] # s
       /\ assign' = [assign EXCEPT ![p] = s]
  /\ leader' = leader
  /\ down' = down

CrashLeader ==
  /\ leader # "none"
  /\ down' = down \cup {leader}
  /\ leader' = "none"
  /\ assign' = assign

Recover ==
  /\ \E s \in Servers :
       /\ s \in down
       /\ down' = down \ {s}
  /\ leader' = leader
  /\ assign' = assign

Next == Elect \/ AssignSlot \/ CrashLeader \/ Recover
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
NoDoubleSlot ==
  \A p \in Players, q \in Players :
    (p # q /\ assign[p] # 0) => assign[p] # assign[q]
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleSlot
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker assigns players to numbered arena slots. Two matchmaker servers can run the assignment, but only one is the elected leader at a time; assignments are made solely by the current leader. If the leader crashes silently it simply stops and is marked down, leaving no leader until a fresh election picks a healthy server. A player who has no slot yet can be given a free slot, one that no other player currently occupies. The safety concern is that no arena slot is ever handed to two different players.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no two distinct players are assigned the same arena slot.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od17m6p2t3 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
Belts == {"b1", "b2", "b3"}
Total == 3
VARIABLES bags, lease
vars == <<bags, lease>>

TotalBags == bags["b1"] + bags["b2"] + bags["b3"]

Init ==
  /\ bags = [b \in Belts |-> IF b = "b1" THEN Total ELSE 0]
  /\ lease = "free"

Grant ==
  /\ lease = "free"
  /\ \E b \in Belts : lease' = b
  /\ bags' = bags

Expire ==
  /\ lease # "free"
  /\ lease' = "free"
  /\ bags' = bags

Route ==
  /\ lease # "free"
  /\ bags[lease] > 0
  /\ \E d \in Belts :
       /\ d # lease
       /\ bags' = [bags EXCEPT ![lease] = bags[lease] - 1, ![d] = bags[d] + 1]
  /\ lease' = lease

Next == Grant \/ Expire \/ Route
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
BagConservation == TotalBags = Total
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT BagConservation
nl:
An airport baggage router moves bags across three conveyor belts. A belt must hold the routing lease before it may push a bag onward to another belt; the lease is granted to one belt at a time and can expire back to free. A belt may be slow but never fails, so a bag it holds is not lost, merely delayed. Every bag is always on exactly one belt: routing moves a bag from one belt to another but never creates or drops a bag. The router starts with all bags queued on the first belt.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of bags summed across all three belts is constant over time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od0m0p3t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
Rooms == {"or1", "or2"}
Surgeries == {"s1", "s2"}
VARIABLES occupant, ver, openRooms
vars == <<occupant, ver, openRooms>>

Init ==
  /\ occupant = [r \in Rooms |-> "none"]
  /\ ver = [r \in Rooms |-> 0]
  /\ openRooms = Rooms

Book ==
  /\ \E r \in Rooms, s \in Surgeries :
       /\ r \in openRooms
       /\ occupant[r] = "none"
       /\ \A q \in Rooms : occupant[q] # s
       /\ ver[r] < 3
       /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = s]
       /\ ver' = [ver EXCEPT ![r] = ver[r] + 1]
  /\ openRooms' = openRooms

Discharge ==
  /\ \E r \in Rooms :
       /\ occupant[r] # "none"
       /\ occupant' = [occupant EXCEPT ![r] = "none"]
  /\ ver' = ver
  /\ openRooms' = openRooms

Toggle ==
  /\ \E r \in Rooms :
       IF r \in openRooms /\ occupant[r] = "none"
         THEN openRooms' = openRooms \ {r}
         ELSE openRooms' = openRooms \cup {r}
  /\ occupant' = occupant
  /\ ver' = ver

Next == Book \/ Discharge \/ Toggle
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
NoDoubleBooking ==
  \A r \in Rooms, q \in Rooms :
    (r # q /\ occupant[r] # "none") => occupant[r] # occupant[q]
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleBooking
nl:
A hospital operating-room scheduler assigns pending surgeries to operating rooms. Booking uses optimistic locking: a scheduler reads a room's version stamp, and its booking only takes effect if the stamp is unchanged, otherwise it retries. The set of usable rooms can change at runtime as rooms open or close for cleaning, changing capacity. A surgery may be booked into a room only if that room currently holds no other surgery. The overriding safety rule is that a single operating room is never double-booked with two surgeries at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no operating room is assigned to two different surgeries simultaneously.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od2m1p3t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
Robots == {0, 1, 2}
Lanes == {"L1", "L2"}
VARIABLES token, claims
vars == <<token, claims>>

ClaimedLanes == {c.lane : c \in claims}

Init ==
  /\ token = 0
  /\ claims = {}

Claim ==
  /\ \E l \in Lanes :
       /\ l \notin ClaimedLanes
       /\ claims' = claims \cup {[robot |-> token, lane |-> l]}
  /\ token' = token

Release ==
  /\ \E c \in claims :
       /\ c.robot = token
       /\ claims' = claims \ {c}
  /\ token' = token

PassToken ==
  /\ token' = (token + 1) % 3
  /\ claims' = claims

Next == Claim \/ Release \/ PassToken
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
NoLaneDoubleClaim ==
  \A c1 \in claims, c2 \in claims :
    (c1.lane = c2.lane) => (c1.robot = c2.robot)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLaneDoubleClaim
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet coordinates access to loading lanes using a token ring: a single token circulates among three robots, and only the robot currently holding the token may claim a lane. Two independent fleet controllers share the same pool of lanes. A robot holding the token can claim a free lane (one not already claimed by any robot), or pass the token to the next robot in the ring. A claimed lane can later be released. The essential rule is that the same lane is never claimed by two different robots at the same time.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no loading lane is claimed by two different robots at once.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od12m6p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
Instances == {"i1", "i2"}
VARIABLES rec, lease, lastVer
vars == <<rec, lease, lastVer>>

Init ==
  /\ rec = [units |-> 3, ver |-> 0]
  /\ lease = "free"
  /\ lastVer = 0

AcquireLease ==
  /\ lease = "free"
  /\ \E i \in Instances : lease' = i
  /\ rec' = rec
  /\ lastVer' = lastVer

Expire ==
  /\ lease # "free"
  /\ lease' = "free"
  /\ rec' = rec
  /\ lastVer' = lastVer

Write ==
  /\ lease # "free"
  /\ rec.ver < 3
  /\ lastVer' = rec.ver
  /\ rec' = [units |-> IF rec.units = 0 THEN 3 ELSE rec.units - 1, ver |-> rec.ver + 1]
  /\ lease' = lease

Next == AcquireLease \/ Expire \/ Write
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
NoLostUpdate == rec.ver >= lastVer
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A blood-bank inventory record tracks the current unit count and a version number. Two independent tracker instances share this one pooled record, but writes are serialized by a lease: an instance must hold the current lease before it may update the record, and only one lease is outstanding at a time. Acquiring the lease is only possible when it is free; the lease can expire and return to free. When a lease-holder writes, it bumps the version number by one, so no update is ever silently lost or overwritten out of order. Versions only ever move forward.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the record's version number never decreases, and a write only occurs while some instance holds the lease.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od16m6p6t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
Instances == {"i1", "i2"}
VARIABLES holder, epoch, seen, badDispenses
vars == <<holder, epoch, seen, badDispenses>>

Init ==
  /\ holder = "none"
  /\ epoch = 0
  /\ seen = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
  /\ badDispenses = 0

Grant ==
  /\ holder = "none"
  /\ epoch < 3
  /\ \E i \in Instances :
       /\ holder' = i
       /\ epoch' = epoch + 1
       /\ seen' = [seen EXCEPT ![i] = epoch + 1]
  /\ badDispenses' = badDispenses

Expire ==
  /\ holder # "none"
  /\ holder' = "none"
  /\ epoch' = epoch
  /\ seen' = seen
  /\ badDispenses' = badDispenses

Dispense ==
  /\ holder # "none"
  /\ seen[holder] = epoch
  /\ badDispenses' = badDispenses + (IF seen[holder] = epoch THEN 0 ELSE 1)
  /\ holder' = holder
  /\ epoch' = epoch
  /\ seen' = seen

Recycle ==
  /\ holder = "none"
  /\ epoch = 3
  /\ epoch' = 0
  /\ seen' = [i \in Instances |-> 0]
  /\ holder' = holder
  /\ badDispenses' = badDispenses

Next == Grant \/ Expire \/ Dispense \/ Recycle
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
NoStaleDispense == badDispenses = 0
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleDispense
nl:
A pharmacy prescription dispenser is driven by two independent dispensing instances that share one drug pool. Authority to dispense is granted by a lease that carries an epoch number; each time the lease is handed out, the epoch is bumped. An instance caches the epoch it last saw. A dispense is only allowed to proceed if the acting instance holds the lease AND the epoch it remembers matches the lease's current epoch, so a stale instance whose lease has since been reissued to someone else can never dispense. The lease may expire and be re-granted, stranding an old holder with an out-of-date epoch.
SAFETY PROPERTY: a dispense action is only ever performed by the instance currently holding the lease with a matching, non-stale epoch.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od5m6p3t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
Players == {"p1", "p2"}
Seats == {1, 2}
VARIABLES seated, pending, lease
vars == <<seated, pending, lease>>

TakenSeats == {s.seat : s \in seated}

Init ==
  /\ seated = {}
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ lease = "free"

Request ==
  /\ \E p \in Players, s \in Seats :
       pending' = pending \cup {[player |-> p, seat |-> s]}
  /\ seated' = seated
  /\ lease' = lease

Acquire ==
  /\ lease = "free"
  /\ \E p \in Players : lease' = p
  /\ seated' = seated
  /\ pending' = pending

Expire ==
  /\ lease # "free"
  /\ lease' = "free"
  /\ seated' = seated
  /\ pending' = pending

Apply ==
  /\ lease # "free"
  /\ \E m \in pending :
       /\ m.seat \notin TakenSeats
       /\ seated' = seated \cup {m}
       /\ pending' = pending \ {m}
  /\ lease' = lease

Next == Request \/ Acquire \/ Expire \/ Apply
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
NoDoubleSeat ==
  \A a \in seated, b \in seated :
    (a.seat = b.seat) => (a.player = b.player)
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoDoubleSeat
nl:
A multiplayer game lobby matchmaker seats players into numbered lobby seats. Seat-grant requests are buffered as an unordered pool of pending messages and may be applied in any order, since the network reorders them freely. A grant is applied only while the matchmaker holds the seating lease, and only if the target seat is still unoccupied; the lease can expire and be re-acquired. The safety concern is that reordering must never let the same seat end up granted to two different players.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no lobby seat is granted to two different players.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m6p4t1 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
Cap == 2
Tokens == {"t1", "t2", "t3"}
VARIABLES inTunnel, pending, lease
vars == <<inTunnel, pending, lease>>

Init ==
  /\ inTunnel = 0
  /\ pending = {}
  /\ lease = "free"

Request ==
  /\ \E t \in Tokens :
       /\ t \notin pending
       /\ pending' = pending \cup {t}
  /\ inTunnel' = inTunnel
  /\ lease' = lease

Grant ==
  /\ lease = "free"
  /\ lease' = "gate"
  /\ inTunnel' = inTunnel
  /\ pending' = pending

Expire ==
  /\ lease = "gate"
  /\ lease' = "free"
  /\ inTunnel' = inTunnel
  /\ pending' = pending

Admit ==
  /\ lease = "gate"
  /\ inTunnel < Cap
  /\ \E t \in pending :
       pending' = pending \ {t}
  /\ inTunnel' = inTunnel + 1
  /\ lease' = lease

Exit ==
  /\ inTunnel > 0
  /\ inTunnel' = inTunnel - 1
  /\ pending' = pending
  /\ lease' = lease

Next == Request \/ Grant \/ Expire \/ Admit \/ Exit
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
CapacityRespected == inTunnel <= Cap
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT CapacityRespected
nl:
A car-wash conveyor tunnel admits cars up to a fixed capacity. Entry requests arrive as an unordered pool of tokens and may be serviced in any order because the gate controller reorders them. A car is admitted only while the controller holds the entry lease and only while the tunnel is below capacity; the lease can expire and be re-granted. Cars leave the far end one at a time. The tunnel must never hold more cars than its capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the number of cars inside the tunnel never exceeds the tunnel capacity.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od19m4p6t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, FiniteSets
Cap == 2
Librarians == {"a", "b"}
VARIABLES queue, authorized, badActions
vars == <<queue, authorized, badActions>>

Init ==
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ authorized = Librarians
  /\ badActions = 0

Enqueue ==
  /\ Len(queue) < Cap
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, "req")
  /\ authorized' = authorized
  /\ badActions' = badActions

Process ==
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ \E w \in Librarians :
       /\ w \in authorized
       /\ badActions' = badActions + (IF w \in authorized THEN 0 ELSE 1)
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ authorized' = authorized

Crash ==
  /\ \E w \in authorized :
       authorized' = authorized \ {w}
  /\ queue' = queue
  /\ badActions' = badActions

Reinstate ==
  /\ \E w \in Librarians :
       /\ w \notin authorized
       /\ authorized' = authorized \cup {w}
  /\ queue' = queue
  /\ badActions' = badActions

Next == Enqueue \/ Process \/ Crash \/ Reinstate
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
OnlyAuthorizedProcess == badActions = 0
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT OnlyAuthorizedProcess
nl:
A library book-reservation system buffers requests in a bounded queue and refuses new ones when full (backpressure). Requests may only be processed by a currently authorized librarian. A librarian may crash silently, which quietly revokes its authorization without any announcement, so a request handled by a librarian that has lost authorization would be an unauthorized action. The system is designed so that only authorized librarians ever pull and process requests off the queue.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no reservation request is ever processed by an unauthorized (crashed) librarian.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od15m4p1t0 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
Cap == 2
VARIABLES queue, book, dequeued, crashed
vars == <<queue, book, dequeued, crashed>>

Init ==
  /\ queue = << >>
  /\ book = [rev |-> 0]
  /\ dequeued = 0
  /\ crashed = FALSE

Enqueue ==
  /\ Len(queue) < Cap
  /\ dequeued + Len(queue) < 4
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, "order")
  /\ book' = book
  /\ dequeued' = dequeued
  /\ crashed' = crashed

Apply ==
  /\ ~crashed
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ book' = [rev |-> book.rev + 1]
  /\ dequeued' = dequeued + 1
  /\ queue' = Tail(queue)
  /\ crashed' = crashed

Crash ==
  /\ ~crashed
  /\ crashed' = TRUE
  /\ queue' = queue
  /\ book' = book
  /\ dequeued' = dequeued

Resume ==
  /\ crashed
  /\ crashed' = FALSE
  /\ queue' = queue
  /\ book' = book
  /\ dequeued' = dequeued

Next == Enqueue \/ Apply \/ Crash \/ Resume
Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars
NoLostUpdate == book.rev = dequeued
====
cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoLostUpdate
nl:
A stock exchange opening auction buffers incoming orders in a bounded queue and folds them one at a time into a shared order book. Each time an order is applied, the book's revision counter advances, and a running tally of orders taken off the queue is kept. Because every dequeued order must be reflected exactly once, the book's revision counter must always equal the number of orders dequeued: no update is lost and none is applied twice. An auction processor may crash silently and stop applying, but the book it already built is not corrupted; a fresh processor can resume.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the order book's revision counter always equals the number of orders that have been dequeued, so no order update is ever lost or duplicated.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od8m4p2t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences
Total == 3
QCap == 2
VARIABLES free, enrolled, queue
vars == <<free, enrolled, queue>>

Init ==
  /\ free = Total
  /\ enrolled = 0
  /\ queue = << >>

Submit ==
  /\ Len(queue) < QCap
  /\ queue' = Append(queue, "reg")
  /\ free' = free
  /\ enrolled' = enrolled

Enroll ==
  /\ Len(queue) > 0
  /\ free > 0

nl:
A university course-registration system manages a fixed pool of seats for one course. Two independent registration instances share this same seat pool. Registration requests are buffered in a bounded queue; processing a request from the front consumes one free seat and turns it into an enrollment, provided a free seat exists. A student may later withdraw, turning an enrollment back into a free seat. Seats are a conserved quantity: the number of free seats plus the number of enrollments always equals the fixed course capacity.

nl:
An airport baggage router moves bags between two zones, each zone containing two chutes. Moving a bag requires a hierarchical lock: first a coarse zone lock, then a fine chute lock beneath it, and both must be held before a bag is transferred. A holder may crash silently, leaving its locks stuck until a supervisor reclaims them. Whatever happens with locks and crashes, bags are conserved: a transfer relocates a bag from one chute to another but never creates or loses a bag. The router starts with all bags on the first chute.

cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleExecution
nl:
A warehouse robot fleet is periodically reconfigured in numbered epochs by a coordinator. Each reconfiguration advances the global epoch and stamps every robot with the new epoch as it is notified. A robot may be slow but not failed, so it can lag one or more epochs behind before it catches up. A robot may only execute a fleet command if the epoch it currently carries matches the global epoch; a lagging robot carrying an old epoch must refuse to act. The design guarantees that a stale robot never performs a command.
SAFETY PROPERTY: no robot ever executes a command while carrying an epoch older than the current global epoch.

nl:
A university course-registration system enrolls students through a two-phase commit against a fixed seat capacity. To enroll, the registrar first prepares a tentative seat reservation, which provisionally holds one seat, then either commits it into a confirmed enrollment or aborts it back. A privileged admin may also confirm an enrollment directly, bypassing the prepare step. Confirmed enrollments plus any seat currently held by a prepared-but-uncommitted reservation must never exceed the course capacity.
SAFETY PROPERTY: confirmed enrollments plus any provisionally reserved seat never exceed the fixed capacity.

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT NoStaleOverwrite
nl:
A smart-home door-lock network keeps one shared configuration record holding the current lock policy and an epoch number. Two independent hub instances share this record. The network is reconfigured in epochs: each reconfiguration bumps the epoch and rewrites the policy. A hub may only rewrite the policy as part of advancing to a strictly newer epoch, so a stale write carrying an old epoch can never clobber a newer configuration. The stored epoch therefore only ever moves forward, and no newer update is lost to an older one.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the configuration epoch never decreases; every rewrite strictly advances it.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od10m2p1t2 ----
EXTENDS Naturals
VARIABLES rec, prepared, lastRev
vars == <<rec, prepared, lastRev>>

Init ==
  /\ rec = [occ |-> FALSE, rev |-> 0]
  /\ prepared = [active |-> FALSE, occ |-> FALSE, rev |-> 0]
  /\ lastRev = 0

Prepare ==
  /\ ~prepared.active
  /\ rec.rev < 3
  /\ \E b \in {TRUE, FALSE} :
       prepared' = [active |-> TRUE, occ |-> b, rev |-> rec.rev + 1]

  /\ lastRev' = lastRev

  /\ prepared.active
  /\ prepared.rev = rec.rev + 1
  /\ lastRev' = rec.rev
  /\ rec' = [occ |-> prepared.occ, rev |-> prepared.rev]
  /\ prepared' = [active |-> FALSE, occ |-> FALSE, rev |-> 0]

Abort ==
  /\ prepared.active
  /\ prepared' = [active |-> FALSE, occ |-> FALSE, rev |-> 0]
  /\ rec' = rec
  /\ lastRev' = lastRev

  /\ prepared' = prepared
  /\ lastRev' = lastRev

INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT MonotoneRevision
nl:
A subway signalling block system guards one shared block-occupancy record, updated through a two-phase commit. Two independent signalling instances share the record. To change the record an instance first prepares a proposed new occupancy along with the next revision number, then commits it, which installs the proposal and advances the record's revision counter; alternatively the prepared change is aborted. A prepared revision always equals the current revision plus one, so a commit can never install a stale value or skip a revision, and no update is silently lost.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the block-occupancy record's revision counter never decreases and advances by exactly one on each commit.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od4m2p0t0 ----

  /\ crashed' = crashed

  /\ phase = "prepared"
  /\ phase' = "idle"

  /\ crashed' = crashed

  /\ running' = running - 1
  /\ phase' = phase
  /\ crashed' = crashed

Crash ==
  /\ phase = "prepared"
  /\ ~crashed
  /\ crashed' = TRUE
  /\ phase' = phase
  /\ running' = running

Recover ==
  /\ crashed
  /\ crashed' = FALSE
  /\ phase' = "idle"
  /\ running' = running

INVARIANT BayMutualExclusion
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line has a single wash bay that at most one car cycle may occupy. Starting a wash cycle uses a two-phase commit between the intake controller and the bay: the controller prepares a cycle, then commits it to actually begin washing, or aborts the preparation. A running cycle later finishes and frees the bay. The bay's controller may crash silently while a preparation is outstanding, stranding it until a supervisor clears it. The invariant that matters is that the wash bay is never running two car cycles at once.
SAFETY PROPERTY: at most one car wash cycle is running in the bay at any time.

A hospital operating-room scheduler controls the irreversible act of starting a surgery for each case. Starting a case requires a hierarchical lock: a coarse department lock, then a fine case lock beneath it. Once a case has been started, that start is irreversible and must never happen a second time for the same case. A privileged admin may start a case directly under an emergency override, still respecting the once-only rule. The scheduler tracks which cases have already been started so no case is ever started twice.

NEXT Next
INVARIANT TrainConservation
nl:
A subway signalling system tracks how many trains occupy each of three track blocks. A train moves from one block to an adjacent block using a compare-and-swap: the mover reads the destination block's count and only completes the move if that count still matches what it read, otherwise it retries. A privileged dispatcher may also relocate a train directly, overriding the compare-and-swap. Whatever the mechanism, trains are conserved: a move relocates one train between blocks, never creating or destroying one. The system starts with all trains in the first block.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total number of trains across the three blocks is invariant over time.

spec_text:
---- MODULE W4Od14m5p5t4 ----
EXTENDS Naturals, FiniteSets
Drones == {"d1", "d2", "d3"}
Targets == {"t1", "t2"}

vars == <<dropped, active, votes>>

Init ==
  /\ dropped = [t \in Targets |-> 0]
  /\ active = Drones
  /\ votes = 0

Join ==
  /\ \E d \in Drones :
       /\ d \notin active
       /\ active' = active \cup {d}
  /\ dropped' = dropped
  /\ votes' = votes

Leave ==
  /\ \E d \in active :
       active' = active \ {d}
  /\ dropped' = dropped
  /\ votes' = votes

Vote ==
  /\ votes < Cardinality(active)
  /\ votes' = votes + 1
  /\ active' = active
  /\ dropped' = dropped

Drop ==
  /\ votes * 2 > Cardinality(active)
  /\ \E t \in Targets :
       /\ dropped[t] = 0
       /\ dropped' = [dropped EXCEPT ![t] = 1]
  /\ votes' = 0
  /\ active' = active

Next == Join \/ Leave \/ Vote \/ Drop

NEXT Next
INVARIANT DropAtMostOnce
nl:
A wildfire drone surveillance swarm decides, per ground target, whether to drop fire retardant. Dropping retardant on a target is irreversible and must happen at most once per target. A drop is authorized only by a quorum vote: a majority of the currently active drones must approve before the drop is executed. The number of active drones can change at runtime as drones join or leave the swarm, which shifts what counts as a majority, but the once-per-target rule always holds. The swarm records which targets have already been treated.
SAFETY PROPERTY: fire retardant is dropped on each target at most once.

cfg_text:
INIT Init
NEXT Next
INVARIANT FoamConservation
nl:
A car-wash conveyor line meters foam units across three dispensers. Moving foam from one dispenser to another requires a hierarchical lock: a coarse manifold lock, then a fine dispenser lock. The total foam a dispenser may hold, its capacity, can change at runtime as nozzles are swapped, but re-capping never changes how much foam exists. A transfer relocates one unit of foam between dispensers, subject to the destination's capacity, and never creates or destroys foam. The line starts with all foam in the first dispenser.
SAFETY PROPERTY: the total amount of foam summed across all dispensers stays constant.
